mapper.select: select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.is_public, d.created_at, f.file_extension, s.view_count, s.download_count from sd_gis_dataset d left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id left join sd_dataset_stat s on d.dataset_id = s.dataset_id where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null order by d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc;
mapper.sql:
from sd_gis_dataset d left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id and f.file_role = 'ORIGINAL' left join sd_dataset_stat s on d.dataset_id = s.dataset_id left join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null
and ( lower(d.title) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(d.description, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(d.provider, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(c.category_name_ko, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') )
and d.provider = #{provider}
and lower(replace(coalesce(f.file_extension, ''), '.', '')) = lower(replace(#{fileFormat}, '.', ''))
and d.category_id = #{categoryId}
and d.created_at >= CAST(#{startDate} AS date)
and d.created_at < CAST(#{endDate} AS date) + interval '1 day'

and exists ( select 1 from sd_download_log dl where dl.dataset_id = d.dataset_id and dl.created_at >= current_date and dl.created_at < current_date + interval '1 day' and upper(coalesce(dl.download_status, 'SUCCESS')) = 'SUCCESS' )

choose.when: order by coalesce(s.view_count, 0) desc, d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc
order by coalesce(s.download_count, 0) desc, d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc
order by coalesce(d.updated_at, d.created_at) desc, d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc
order by d.title asc, d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc
choose.otherwise: order by d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc

mapper.select:
select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.category_id, c.category_name_ko, d.is_public, d.created_at, f.file_extension, coalesce(s.view_count, 0) as view_count, coalesce(s.download_count, 0) as download_count,
exists ( select 1 from sd_dataset_favorite fav where fav.dataset_id = d.dataset_id and fav.user_id = #{userId} ) as favorite
false as favorite
limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(distinct d.dataset_id)

select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.category_id, c.category_name_ko, d.is_public, d.created_at, f.file_extension, coalesce(s.view_count, 0) as view_count, coalesce(s.download_count, 0) as download_count,
exists ( select 1 from sd_dataset_favorite fav where fav.dataset_id = d.dataset_id and fav.user_id = #{userId} ) as favorite
false as favorite
limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(distinct d.dataset_id)
select distinct d.provider from sd_gis_dataset d where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null and d.provider is not null and d.provider != '' order by d.provider

select distinct upper(replace(f.file_extension, '.', '')) as file_format from sd_gis_dataset d inner join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id and f.file_role = 'ORIGINAL' where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null and f.file_extension is not null and f.file_extension != '' order by file_format

select distinct c.category_id, c.category_name_ko from sd_data_category c inner join sd_gis_dataset d on c.category_id = d.category_id where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null and c.deleted_at is null order by c.category_name_ko

select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.category_id, c.category_name_ko, d.is_public, d.created_at, f.file_extension, coalesce(s.view_count, 0) as view_count, coalesce(s.download_count, 0) as download_count from sd_gis_dataset d left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id and f.file_role = 'ORIGINAL' left join sd_dataset_stat s on d.dataset_id = s.dataset_id left join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null order by coalesce(s.download_count, 0) desc, d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc limit 1

select f.feature_id, f.feature_name, f.spatial_type, f.properties::text as properties_json, ST_AsText(ST_MakeValid(f.geom_4326)) as geometry_wkt, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_MakeValid(f.geom_4326), 5) as geometry_json from sd_gis_feature f where f.dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by f.feature_id limit 5

select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.category_id, c.category_name_ko, d.is_public, d.created_at, f.file_extension, coalesce(s.view_count, 0) as view_count, coalesce(s.download_count, 0) as download_count from sd_gis_dataset d left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id and f.file_role = 'ORIGINAL' left join sd_dataset_stat s on d.dataset_id = s.dataset_id left join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null and d.dataset_id != #{datasetId} and d.category_id = ( select category_id from sd_gis_dataset where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and deleted_at is null ) order by coalesce(s.download_count, 0) desc, d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc limit 3

select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.source_type, d.spatial_type, d.file_format, d.original_srid, d.storage_srid, d.analysis_srid, d.is_spatial, d.is_public, d.status, c.category_name_ko, d.created_at, d.updated_at from sd_gis_dataset d inner join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} and d.deleted_at is null;
select dataset_id, view_count, download_count, updated_at, created_at from sd_dataset_stat where dataset_id = #{datasetId}

select file_id, dataset_id, file_role, original_filename, stored_filename, file_path, file_extension, file_size, mime_type, encoding, checksum, created_at from sd_gis_dataset_file where dataset_id = #{datasetId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sd_dataset_view_log (dataset_id, user_id, view_ip) values (#{datasetId}, #{userId}, #{viewIp})

insert into sd_download_log ( dataset_id, file_id, user_id, download_format, download_file_size, download_status, error_message, download_ip ) values ( #{datasetId}, #{fileId}, #{userId}, #{downloadFormat}, #{downloadFileSize}, #{downloadStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{downloadIp} )
mapper.select: select organization from sd_user where user_id = #{userId};

with features as ( select jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_MakeValid(f.geom_4326), 5)::jsonb, 'properties', jsonb_build_object( 'featureId', f.feature_id, 'name', f.feature_name, 'spatialType', f.spatial_type ) ) as feature from sd_gis_feature f where f.dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by f.feature_id limit 200 ) select jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', coalesce(jsonb_agg(feature), '[]'::jsonb) )::text from features

with features as ( select jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_MakeValid(f.geom_4326), 5)::jsonb, 'properties', jsonb_build_object( 'featureId', f.feature_id, 'name', f.feature_name, 'spatialType', f.spatial_type ) || coalesce(f.properties, '{}'::jsonb) ) as feature from sd_gis_feature f where f.dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by f.feature_id ) select jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', coalesce(jsonb_agg(feature), '[]'::jsonb) )::text from features

select f.feature_id, f.feature_name, f.spatial_type, f.properties::text as properties_json, ST_AsText(ST_MakeValid(f.geom_4326)) as geometry_wkt, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_MakeValid(f.geom_4326), 5) as geometry_json from sd_gis_feature f where f.dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by f.feature_id
